summary.business_type: B2B technical services — event detection & alerting systems (Coquimbo, Chile); light local component
top_findings: Soft-404: every unmatched route returns HTTP 200 serving the homepage
.html URLs 308-redirect to clean URLs, but canonical/sitemap/internal links still use .html
Primary keyword absent from homepage <title> and <h1>
No About/Nosotros page and no Terms page (E-E-A-T gaps)
quick_wins: Add 404.html (Cloudflare Pages serves it with a real 404 status)
Point canonical + sitemap + internal links to /privacidad (not /privacidad.html)
Add primary keyword to the homepage title

findings.title: Soft-404 (200 for unmatched routes)
findings.description: /pagina-basura-xyz and /llms.txt both return 200 serving index.html. Unlimited duplicate homepages are indexable.
findings.recommendation: Add a 404.html at repo root; Cloudflare Pages serves it with a 404 status for unmatched routes.

findings.title: .html -> clean-URL 308 with canonical/sitemap mismatch
findings.description: /privacidad.html 308-redirects to /privacidad, but the served page's canonical is /privacidad.html and the sitemap + footer links reference /privacidad.html, causing a redirect hop and a canonical that points at a redirecting URL.
findings.recommendation: Reference /privacidad (extensionless) in the canonical tag, sitemap.xml, and all internal links; or disable Cloudflare clean-URL rewriting.

findings.title: No About/Nosotros page
findings.description: No dedicated About page to establish who RedLocal is (experience, people, credentials) — a core E-E-A-T signal.
findings.recommendation: Add /nosotros with company story, team, expertise, and location.

findings.title: No Terms page
findings.description: Terms of Service page was removed with legacy/ and is not linked anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Restore a Terms page and link it in the footer.

findings.title: Weak author/entity signals
findings.description: No author, organization credentials, or sameAs profiles to reinforce authority.
findings.recommendation: Add sameAs social/professional profiles and author/company credentials.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: clean heading hierarchy (1 H1, 8 H2, 23 H3)

findings.title: Primary keyword absent from homepage title/H1
findings.description: Title and H1 are emotional/brand-led ('Cuando ocurra algo importante...'). The core keyword (sistemas de alertas / deteccion de eventos) appears only in the meta and body.
findings.recommendation: Homepage brand + keyword, e.g. 'RedLocal — Sistemas de alertas y deteccion de eventos'.

findings.title: Title length 61 chars
findings.description: Slightly over 60; may truncate in SERPs.
findings.recommendation: Trim to <=60 chars when adding the keyword.

findings.title: Missing recommended schema fields
findings.description: Organization missing sameAs; WebSite missing potentialAction (SearchAction).
findings.recommendation: Add sameAs (social profiles) and a SearchAction; consider BreadcrumbList on inner pages.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: self-hosted subset fonts with preload + font-display:swap

findings.title: Field CWV not verified
findings.description: PageSpeed/CrUX not measured (no PSI API key or GSC/CrUX access). Lab indicators are strong; self-hosting fonts should improve LCP vs the previous Google Fonts setup.
findings.recommendation: Set a PageSpeed API key or connect GSC/CrUX to confirm field CWV.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: AI crawlers not blocked in robots.txt

findings.title: No real llms.txt
findings.description: /llms.txt returns 200 but is the soft-404 fallback (home HTML), not a real llms.txt.
findings.recommendation: Add a genuine /llms.txt summarizing the site for AI crawlers (optional; ignored by Google).

findings.title: Limited citability signals
findings.description: No FAQ schema or explicit Q&A blocks that AI engines cite easily.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQPage schema for common questions; keep concise, quotable passages.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Home hero is accessible inline SVG (role=img + aria-label)

findings.title: No on-page raster images to optimize
findings.description: Home has no tags; hero is SVG. Nothing to fix.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Add 404.html to stop soft-404 (200) on unmatched routes
Fix /privacidad canonical + sitemap + internal links to extensionless URL

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add primary keyword to homepage title (<=60 chars)

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect GSC + PageSpeed/CrUX to verify field CWV and indexation
